critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 2685 lines (grew by 76 lines with demo-driver seed + cruise task). Refactor into modules/{auth,trips,driver,fleet,admin}.py is overdue (flagged since iter10).

cruise_demo_drivers loops forever with only a broad `except Exception: pass` — no logging on failure means a silent stall would go unnoticed. Add logger.warning around exceptions and a heartbeat metric.

/api/cars/nearby recalculates last_location_at freshness filter (60s) — this correctly excludes demos if cruise task stalls, but also means if a real driver's connection blips >60s they vanish from map. Consider 120s for real drivers vs 60s for demos.

/driver/trip/{id}/start and /arrive return {'ok': True} instead of full trip — inconsistent with /driver/accept which returns full trip. Consider standardizing so passenger UI can rely on a single response shape (would have simplified my test verification too).

Demo drivers use plate format 'AB 11101' (with space) while real driver uses 'EL12345' (no space) — no format validation in seed or user create. Enforce e.g. Pydantic validator on plate field to match Norwegian format regex.

AIChat.jsx VEHICLE_META icons now use lucide components (good), but the whole AIChat still uses mint color tokens — either move it out of the brass-polished passenger set OR complete the migration. Half-migrated is worse than fully mint or fully brass.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 16 stable — beta-ready. KEY REMINDERS: (1) /driver/accept endpoint is POST /api/driver/accept with body {trip_id} — NOT /driver/trip/{id}/accept (that path does not exist). (2) /driver/trip/{id}/start and /arrive return {'ok': True} only; use GET /api/trips/{id} to see the updated trip. (3) ola@kjapp.no often has stale active trips left over from prior E2E runs — always call GET /api/trips/active then POST /api/trips/{trip_id}/cancel to clean before new booking test, or booking will re-enter 'Søker sjåfør' searching state instead of showing home map with 6 cars. (4) Driver login testids are dlogin-email/dlogin-password/dlogin-submit (NOT driver-login-*). (5) On mobile viewport, ALWAYS pre-set localStorage['kjapp_cookie_consent']='all' before interacting with bottom-anchored sheets (still true from iter15). (6) Backend cruise task moves demo drivers ~step=0.0002 deg every 6s; positions won't collide with real drivers. (7) demo drivers have plate 'AB 11101' style (with space) while real sjafor is 'EL12345' — Playwright text matchers must account for both. (8) AIChat.jsx still has 4 mint refs + 1 hardcoded #131a1f — flagged as design_issue not a blocker.
